method: static read-only review; no code executed, no models run

findings.description: self.last_trace/self.last_calls are instance attributes reset and appended per evaluate_async call, not call-scoped. Reusing one committee instance for two concurrent evaluate_async calls (not done today but not prevented) corrupts/truncates both companies' trace and call-accounting silently.
findings.not_a_bug_because: NativeBinding itself (ContextVar-scoped) is correctly isolated per call; the defect is narrowly the instance attributes on the committee object.
findings.test_proposed: asyncio.gather two evaluate_async calls on one NativeDialecticCommittee with distinct CommitteeInput views; assert last_trace/last_calls/cited_fact_ids partition cleanly per company_id and neither call's data is lost.
findings.fix_direction: return trace/calls from evaluate_async instead of storing on self, or document+assert one-instance-per-concurrent-call.

findings.description: install() only guards against double-install on the SAME instance (self._original check). Two independent instances installed while one is still active capture each other's already-patched methods as 'original', so restore() ordering determines whether the socket module ends up truly unpatched or still wrapped.
findings.current_exposure: not hit by existing tests (only one instance per test class), but a landmine for future nested/leaked guard usage.
findings.test_proposed: install g1, install g2 (should not silently succeed with corrupted original capture, or must compose safely), restore in both orders, assert final socket.socket.connect/bind identity equals the true pre-g1 original after both are restored regardless of order.
findings.fix_direction: module-level installed-guard stack/lock, or refuse second install process-wide, or capture true originals via a persistent module-level reference set once.

findings.description: ipaddress.ip_address(address[0]) raises ValueError for hostnames (e.g. 'localhost'), treated as not-loopback and denied. Fails closed, not a security hole; just means test authors must use literal 127.0.0.1/::1.
findings.action: document as constraint; no fix required.

findings.description: On BudgetStopped raised inside one asyncio.gather sibling (e.g. mid score_and_select_best_k), CallBudget.reserve's finally:active-=1 still fires for cancelled siblings since cancellation arrives as an exception inside the active 'with' block.
findings.gap: reasoned correct from code inspection only; no existing test forces a mid-gather failure.
findings.test_proposed: fixture backend raising BudgetStopped on the Nth of several parallel score_single_argument calls; assert budget.active==0 afterward and used['model'] reflects only completed reservations.

findings.description: Every retry of score_single_argument's wrong-criterion-count loop goes through ainvoke and is metered; already covered by test_original_internal_score_count_retry_is_metered.
Final evidence-review call is metered in last_calls but has no matching event(stage) trace row, unlike generation/critique/score_and_select/refinement/final_aggregation.
findings.fix_direction: add event('evidence_review') for audit parity; not a correctness issue.

findings.description: Worst-case node executions = 4*max_research_passes+1; configured recursion_limit=4*max_research_passes+4 has margin, not a deficit as initially suspected. No bug found on recount.
findings.test_proposed: run both ClosedLoopRuntime.run() and graph_driver.run_graph() against an always-gaps fixture that exhausts every research pass; assert identical stop_reason/decision/argument_revision and no GraphRecursionError, to lock in the margin against future stage additions.
